Duration constant

You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Grapple a creature that has damaged or targeted your Ward this encounter, and to the DC of your Grab against that creature's attempts to Escape. While you have such a creature grabbed you can't be Disarmed, and becoming frightened or fleeing doesn't make you release it. If you release it while it can still reach the Ward, that is a breach: you take a −1 status penalty to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
